title: Deeper/broader peer failure-mode crosswalk: block sequence and binary integrity
mode: Primary-source issue/specification review cross-checked against current local writer, adapter, tests, and plan
scope: Reconcile current LibreDWG block omission and INSERT-sequence reports with libdxfrw's distinct writer route.
Refresh binary DXF width, block-owner, table-merge, spline, and MLEADER peer issue status against existing local plan owners.
Refine one compact generated ASCII/Binary implementation gate while preserving local-only fixture policy and fast validation cadence.

local_source_files_inspected: tests/block_owner_tests.cpp: consecutive named-block and INSERT/ATTRIB/SEQEND generated controls
tests/CMakeLists.txt: existing block-owner target and fast CTest registration
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing PAR-49/7G.3 and PAR-39/7X owners
local_checks: Compared the LibreDWG #1409 reported shared object-array cursor mutation with local callback-driven dxfRW::writeBlocks; no equivalent local cursor mechanism was found.

Confirmed local tests separately cover consecutive named blocks and block-owned INSERT/ATTRIB/SEQEND sequences, but the reviewed assertions do not combine an attribute-rich INSERT before adjacent anonymous and paper-space definitions with a table/body identity bijection.
Reconciled LibreDWG #1351's maintainer/reporter note that its `66=1` missing sequence case was fixed on named master commit 56a05f98.

Reconciled ACadRust #136 with local DxfValueKind primitive validation, NUL rejection, generated width guards, and LWPOLYLINE family coverage; exhaustive high-level call-site coverage remains owned by PAR-39/7X.
Reconciled ACadRust #133/#130/#134 and ACadSharp #1299/#1277 with existing owner, TABLE, auxiliary-record, SPLINE, and fail-closed MLEADER plan owners.
Updated the parity-plan top summary and appended a detailed implementation-readiness crosswalk; made no source, test, fixture, dependency, or support-claim change.
method.limitations: Peer issues are route-, build-, and version-scoped reports, not format authorities or libdxfrw reproductions. LibreDWG issue #1409's trigger and recovery counts are reporter evidence. ACadRust candidate commits and issue comments do not establish current released behavior without pinned retest. ACadSharp #1299's attached drawing was not downloaded or inspected, and its spline diagnosis was not independently established. No local test was executed because this pass only refines the plan.

sources.name: LibreDWG issue #1409: block definitions omitted by shared cursor advancement
sources.observed: The issue reports ASCII and Binary-DXF block-body omission when the block scan loop index is also advanced across child objects; later comments describe named blocks, anonymous dimension blocks, paper-space bodies, and attribute-rich INSERTs as relevant shapes.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Peer-specific writer failure; not the same implementation mechanism as libdxfrw and not a local defect reproduction.

sources.name: LibreDWG current mutable DXF block writer source
sources.observed: The issue points to the block scan passing its loop index into the block writer; exact current behavior is mutable-source evidence and should be pinned before any peer execution.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Source-location corroboration only; no peer source was cloned or built.

sources.name: Autodesk BLOCKS section contract
sources.observed: The BLOCKS section contains block definitions and each definition's entities; its entities occur between BLOCK and ENDBLK markers.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Structural DXF contract; does not qualify DWG source-reader retention or application rendering.

sources.name: Autodesk BLOCKS group-code example
sources.observed: The published example shows BLOCK, its body records, ENDBLK, and the BLOCKS section boundary.

sources.name: Autodesk INSERT group 66 reference
sources.observed: Group 66 value 1 signals that ATTRIB records follow the INSERT and are terminated by SEQEND.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Wire-sequence rule only; not a complete DWG attribute-graph qualification.

sources.name: Autodesk SEQEND reference
sources.observed: SEQEND marks the end of an INSERT's attribute sequence when the INSERT indicates attributes follow.

sources.name: LibreDWG issue #1351: INSERT attribute sequence output
sources.observed: A later issue comment records the reproduction fixed on named LibreDWG master commit 56a05f98, with ATTRIB and SEQEND emitted in the comparison.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Named peer master observation, not a current libdxfrw bug or independent support result.

sources.name: ACadRust issue #136: Binary-DXF group widths and embedded NUL
sources.observed: The issue reports 60 hard-coded numeric writer call sites across 15 group codes in ACadRust 0.6.4, same-codec readback accepting malformed output, and a separate NUL-string framing concern.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Peer release-specific report; local validation remains determined by Autodesk's group-code table and raw-byte tests.

sources.name: ACadRust issue #133: non-null orphan owner rehoming
sources.observed: The report describes erased anonymous dimension-block children rehomed into model space and notes a proposed commit awaiting a corpus recheck.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Private-corpus peer report and candidate fix; no local DWG reproduction.

sources.name: ACadRust issue #130: merged TABLE cells and suppression flags
sources.observed: The issue separates merged-range-to-cell-span projection from DWG table-style flags versus DXF suppression booleans, and links candidate fixes requesting test confirmation.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Peer representation issue; local coverage is already owned by 7G.3d and remains non-native.

sources.name: ACadSharp issue #1299: DWG-to-DXF spline report
sources.observed: The report names ACadSharp 3.8.0, an attached AutoCAD DWG and produced DXF, and downstream GDAL rejection; no independent spline arrays or curve diagnosis are provided in the issue body.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Peer conversion report; no file was downloaded and no libdxfrw defect is inferred.

sources.name: ACadSharp issue #1277: standalone MLEADER context writer audit failure
sources.observed: The issue reports same-reader round-trip success but AutoCAD LT AUDIT errors and dropped standalone annotative MLEADER contexts; maintainer says a larger MLEADER refactor is required.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Peer-specific native writer failure; useful evidence that self-roundtrip is insufficient, not a libdxfrw semantic result.
